Profitable is a startup tycoon game for anyone who has ever dreamed of turning a side project into an empire. Start with one tiny uptime monitor and a handful of paying users. Upgrade your product to raise prices, run marketing to win more customers, and watch your user base grow while churn pulls the other way. Found new companies across Micro-SaaS, AI platforms, indie mobile games, fintech, cloud infrastructure and robotics, each one bigger than the last. Build a team of parody tech legends, with The Wife as CFO and your cat as CEO. Make tough calls in more than a dozen board decisions and ride market news and sector booms. Earn a Stonks License to open the Stonks tab, where stocks pay dividends, GriftCoin pumps and dumps on vibes alone, and Market Call lets you bet in-game cash on where it goes next. Blow your fortune on Founder Flex luxuries, from a gold-plated toilet to the Moon itself. When the time is right, ring the opening bell: every IPO earns permanent prestige points and Patents for the R&D Lab, and unlocks new frontiers in quantum computing, space and neurotech. Your ventures keep earning while you are away, so there is always something waiting when you come back. No accounts, no internet required, and no forced ads: optional ads give you a boost only when you choose to watch one.
